final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f LEFT JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT g.bats AS batting_hand, g.cnt AS fielding_count, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share, g.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS above_average FROM g, t WHERE g.cnt > t.avg_cnt ORDER BY g.cnt DESC
